newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eurotunnel debt plan backed by Cambier group.
newsitem.headline: Eurotunnel debt plan backed by Cambier group.

text.p: A group of Eurotunnel shareholders led by France's Christian Cambier on Wednesday said it would vote in favour of the company's debt-restructuring plan at a shareholder meeting on July 10.

"The Eurotunnel Shareholders' Association made extension of the operating licence a condition of accepting the financial restructuring plan which will be submitted for shareholder approval on July 10," the group said in a statement.
"Under these conditions, now that the essentials of its request have been taken into account, the enlarged bureau of the association has decided to vote in favour," it said.

The association -- one of two groups of investors with relatively small Eurotunnel shareholdings -- did not say how many votes it represented out of the total 930 million shares. Cambier said recently it covered about 25-30 million votes.

The Adacte group of shareholders, which hopes to gather about a third of that number of votes, said earlier it still opposed the debt restructuring and was fighting for creditor banks to give up a large chunk of Eurotunnel's debt.
